weight.title: The Weight Room
weight.dek: Metabolic and hormonal care, prescriber led. For the season when the scales stop answering to effort alone.

cosmetic.title: The Cosmetic Quarter
cosmetic.dek: Skin and appearance, clinically grounded. Looking like yourself, at your best, for longer.

private.title: The Private Room
private.dek: Libido and intimacy, handled with discretion and evidence. Spoken about plainly, behind a door that closes.

recovery.title: The Recovery Wing
recovery.dek: Sleep, repair and recovery. Where the body is rebuilt between the demands placed on it.

items.name: Wegovy
items.copy: A TGA-approved GLP-1 receptor agonist. Slows gastric emptying and acts on appetite-regulating centres in the brain, supporting sustained reduction in food intake under prescriber supervision.

items.name: Mounjaro
items.copy: A TGA-approved dual-incretin agonist, engaging both GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Supports appetite regulation and glycaemic control alongside a prescriber-directed metabolic plan.

items.name: Ozempic
items.copy: A TGA-approved GLP-1 receptor agonist, originally indicated for type 2 diabetes management and used under prescriber direction to support appetite and metabolic control.

items.name: 5-Amino-1MQ
items.copy: Inhibits the NNMT enzyme, preserving the body's NAD+ pool to support mitochondrial activity and fat metabolism at the cellular level.

items.name: SLU-PP-332
items.copy: An exercise-mimetic compound that activates the ERR family of metabolic receptors, supporting fatty-acid oxidation and mitochondrial function consistent with an aerobic training response.

items.name: MK-677 (Ibutamoren)
items.copy: A ghrelin receptor agonist that stimulates the body's own growth hormone and IGF-1 pulse, supporting lean tissue and sleep architecture.

items.name: MK-777 (Acetamoren)
items.copy: A newer-generation ghrelin receptor agonist related to Ibutamoren, engineered for tissue selectivity to support lean mass and recovery-phase sleep without the same appetite signal.

items.name: AOD-9604
items.copy: A modified fragment of human growth hormone isolated for its role in fat metabolism, without the broader growth-hormone signalling of the full molecule.

items.name: CJC-1295 (incl. GHRP-2, GHRP-6 and Ipamorelin combinations)
items.form: Cream, injection or cartridge · GHRH analogue and GH-releasing peptide blends
items.copy: A growth hormone releasing hormone analogue, often paired with a growth hormone releasing peptide. Supports the body's natural GH pulse, feeding both body composition goals and deep sleep quality.

items.name: GHRP-2 / GHRP-6 / Ipamorelin
items.form: Cream, injection or cartridge · growth hormone releasing peptides
items.copy: Growth hormone releasing peptides that stimulate the pituitary's own GH secretion, supporting lean tissue maintenance and the deep-sleep phase where physical repair occurs.

items.name: Tesamorelin
items.copy: A growth hormone releasing hormone analogue studied specifically for its effect on visceral fat, the metabolically active fat carried around the abdomen.

items.name: SARMS S-22
items.form: Injection or cartridge · selective androgen receptor modulator
items.copy: A tissue-selective androgen receptor modulator, engaging muscle and bone androgen receptors while sparing the broader hormonal footprint of anabolic steroids.

items.name: MOTS-c
items.copy: A peptide encoded within the mitochondria itself. Activates the AMPK energy pathway, supporting insulin sensitivity, fat metabolism and the cell's resilience to metabolic stress.

items.name: Enclomiphene / Pregnenolone
items.copy: Supports the body's own LH and FSH signalling to lift natural testosterone production, paired with pregnenolone as a precursor to the broader steroid hormone cascade.

items.name: TRT — Testosterone Cypionate, Enanthate & Primoteston Depot
items.form: Injection, various esters and carrier oils
items.copy: Prescriber-directed testosterone replacement for confirmed low testosterone, supporting energy, body composition and the broader metabolic picture that hormone decline affects.

items.name: Nandrolone
items.copy: An anabolic androgen used in prescriber-directed protocols to support lean tissue and joint comfort during a hormone optimisation plan.

items.name: HCG
items.form: Nasal spray, injection or cartridge · LH-mimetic
items.copy: Mimics luteinising hormone to maintain the testes' own function and fertility signalling, commonly run alongside testosterone therapy.

items.name: Infinity BF Shot
items.copy: A lipotropic combination that supports the transport of fatty acids into the mitochondria for energy use, taken alongside a broader weight program.

items.name: Infinity SD Shot
items.form: IV shot · methionine, inositol, choline, carnitine, methylcobalamin
items.copy: A classic lipotropic blend supporting fat metabolism and liver-level processing of dietary fat.

items.name: Infinity Tri-Shot
items.copy: Amino acids that feed the body's nitric oxide pathway, supporting circulation for both training performance and intimate function.

items.name: Infinity PRFM Shot
items.form: IV shot · carnitine, arginine, B-complex, methylcobalamin
items.copy: A performance-and-recovery blend supporting energy metabolism and the amino acid needs of an active training load.

items.name: Infinity BCAA Shot
items.copy: The three branched-chain amino acids most directly used by muscle tissue, supporting lean mass preservation during a calorie deficit and muscle recovery after training.

items.name: Phosphatidylcholine + Deoxycholic Acid
items.copy: An injectable combination used to break down and clear stubborn localised fat deposits, most often used to refine areas that resist diet and training alone.

items.name: Glutathione
items.copy: The body's own master antioxidant, supporting skin clarity and tone while helping neutralise oxidative stress at the cellular level.

items.name: Infinity Biotin Shot
items.copy: Supports the keratin infrastructure behind hair, skin and nail strength.

items.name: Infinity PIU Shot
items.form: IV shot · dexpanthenol, lysine, glycine, proline, niacinamide
items.copy: Delivers amino acid building blocks for the body's own collagen production, supporting skin structure from the inside.

items.name: Melanotan II
items.copy: A melanocortin receptor agonist studied for its effect on skin pigmentation, with a secondary action on the same libido pathway targeted by PT-141.

items.name: KPV
items.copy: A fragment of the body's own alpha-MSH hormone, retaining its anti-inflammatory signalling without the pigmentation effect. Studied for calming inflamed skin and gut tissue alike.

items.name: Bremelanotide (PT-141)
items.form: Nasal spray, injection or cartridge · melanocortin agonist
items.copy: Acts on melanocortin receptors in the brain's arousal pathway rather than on blood vessels directly, addressing desire at a neurological level.

items.name: Sildenafil / Tadalafil
items.copy: Well-established PDE5 inhibitors that relax blood vessels to support blood flow where it is needed, on the same mechanism used in approved erectile function medicines.

items.name: Oxytocin
items.copy: The body's own bonding hormone, released naturally during intimacy and touch. Used to support connection and ease performance-linked anxiety.

items.name: BPC-157
items.form: Capsule, injection or cartridge · gastric pentadecapeptide
items.copy: A stable fragment of a naturally occurring gastric protective protein, studied for its role in supporting the healing of soft tissue, tendon and gut lining.

items.name: Thymosin Beta-4 (TB4)
items.copy: Regulates the actin protein scaffold cells use to migrate and rebuild, supporting tissue repair after injury or intense physical load.

items.name: BPC/TB4 and BPC/CJC/Ipamorelin/TB4 blends
items.form: Injection or cartridge · combined repair and GH-support blends
items.copy: Combination protocols pairing tissue-repair peptides with growth hormone releasing peptides, layering structural repair with the deep-sleep recovery window.

items.name: Thymosin Alpha-1
items.copy: Supports balanced immune system signalling, studied for its role in immune resilience during periods of physical stress.

items.name: Epitalon
items.form: Capsule, injection or cartridge · pineal peptide
items.copy: A synthetic peptide related to the pineal gland's own signalling, studied for its influence on circadian rhythm and sleep quality.

items.name: Selank
items.copy: A peptide studied for calming effects on the stress response, supporting mental clarity without sedation.

items.name: Semax
items.copy: Studied for supporting focus and cognitive stamina, often used during periods of high mental load.

items.name: Dihexa
items.copy: Engages the hepatocyte growth factor pathway associated with synapse formation, studied for cognitive support and mental sharpness.

items.name: Larazotide
items.copy: Blocks the zonulin receptor pathway responsible for loosening the gut's tight junctions, supporting gut barrier integrity.

items.name: Methylene Blue / Ascorbic Acid
items.copy: Supports mitochondrial electron transport at a cellular level, paired with ascorbic acid for antioxidant balance.

items.name: NAD+ / NMN (with or without Resveratrol)
items.form: Capsule, injection or IV · NAD+ precursor
items.copy: Replenishes the NAD+ coenzyme every cell depends on for energy production, supporting cellular resilience as natural NAD+ levels decline with age.

items.name: TB4 Frag (aa1-4 / aa17-23)
items.copy: An isolated fragment of Thymosin Beta-4 targeting its tissue-repair signalling specifically.

items.name: Vitamin & Mineral IV Therapy
items.form: IV or injection · Ascorbic Acid, B-Complex, B-Complex Plus, Calcium Gluconate, Glutamine, Glycine, Lysine, Magnesium Chloride/Sulphate, Methylcobalamin (B12), Myer's Cocktail, NAD+, Selenium, Taurine, Vitamin D, Zinc
items.copy: Foundational infusion therapy replenishing the vitamins and minerals most depleted by stress, training load and disrupted sleep, supporting energy, immune resilience and recovery between demands.

items.name: Infinity CYF / EB / GB / Methyl B12 / NAD++ / RCVR / RRR Shots
items.form: IV shots · targeted B-vitamin, amino acid and mineral blends
items.copy: A family of targeted infusion blends, each combining B-vitamins, amino acids and minerals for a specific recovery need: calm and sleep support, energy, general wellbeing, or post-exertion recovery.
